title: jmap-types data-type registry: Supports History values for Mark's drafts' rows
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H15. Crates: jmap-types (registry module created by blobext:B1). Size: S.

Decisions 5, 14, 22 and 23. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2 (7.2 row), §3 (jmap-types row), §4 (is_history_type).

In the shared data-type registry table that blobext:B1 creates in jmap-types (columns: type name, capability, can reference blobs, can use for state change, supports history), set or verify the supports-history value of every row from Mark's drafts. Each row must cite its draft, matching the text H14 added and the list decision 22 confirmed (resolves D1):
- chat-00: 7 Yes, ReadPosition and PresenceStatus No
- chat-mimi-00: KeyPackage No (decision 22)
- graph-00: 3 Yes
- graph-edit-00: GraphNodeOp No
- scene-00: 3 Yes, SceneAvatar No
- vtc-00: 3 Yes, VTCParticipant No

IETF rows keep §7.2 Table 1. Task, TaskList and TaskNotification stay off the table here: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 registers no data types, and their rows come from Mark's own updated Tasks draft (decision 23, JMAP-jkl8.9) in bead H24 (JMAP-tna1.3.26). Until then Task/TaskList are covered by OHT's PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION (H1), not by a Yes here.

Acceptance:
- A jmap-types unit test lists, by hand from the drafts, the expected Yes set for Mark's rows and compares it with the table.
- OHT is_history_type returns true for the decision-5 private types and false for the exclusions and KeyPackage (decision 22).
- public-api snapshot and CHANGELOG bullet updated.
